quarterly_data.signal: Oracle's Q1 FY2027 earnings release (quarter ended August 31, 2026): total revenues increased 30% to $19.3 billion; cloud revenues (IaaS + SaaS) increased 62% to $11.6 billion, driven by 121% growth in Cloud Infrastructure (IaaS) to $7.4 billion and 10% growth in Cloud Applications (SaaS) to $4.2 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 FY27 total revenues $19.3 billion (+30%); cloud revenues $11.6 billion (+62%); Cloud Infra (IaaS) $7.4 billion (+121%)

quarterly_data.signal: Oracle booked more than $30 billion of additional AI cloud contracts in Q1 FY2027, increasing Remaining Performance Obligations to $664 billion, up $209 billion year-over-year.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $664 billion (up $209 billion YoY); more than $30 billion of additional AI cloud contracts booked in Q1

quarterly_data.signal: Customer demand for AI Cloud Training and Inferencing Services continues to grow faster than supply. Oracle's Q1 FY2027 revenue growth reflected the delivery of 850MW of additional datacenter capacity; since the end of Q4, Oracle also delivered more than 300,000 GPUs to its AI Cloud customers and almost triple the capacity delivered in Q4 FY26.
quarterly_data.figure: 850MW additional datacenter capacity delivered; more than 300,000 GPUs delivered since the end of Q4

quarterly_data.signal: Guidance: Q2 FY2027 total revenues expected to grow between 30% and 34% in constant currency and USD; total cloud revenue expected to grow between 65% and 71% in USD; non-GAAP EPS between $1.85 and $1.93 in USD. For fiscal year 2027 Oracle now expects total revenue of at least $90 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $8.10.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 FY27 total revenues +30% to 34%; total cloud revenue +65% to 71% (USD); FY27 total revenue at least $90 billion, non-GAAP EPS $8.10
